chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Ṣalt, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from Ibn Bukayr, from Qudāmah ibn Zāʾidah, who said:
I heard Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام say: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the prayer over his son Ibrāhīm and pronounced five takbirs.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam reporting the teaching
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ibrāhīm, the son of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say in the funeral prayer over the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the funeral prayer for his son Ibrāhīm with five takbirs. It serves as evidence in the discussion of the number of takbirs in the prayer over the deceased.
